# Theme Compatibility Matrix
Compatibility between platform themes and structural layouts:
- `theme-minimal`: Compatible with `layout-list`, `layout-grid`, `layout-image-cards`, `layout-editorial`.
- `theme-luxury`: Compatible with `layout-list`, `layout-grid`, `layout-image-cards`, `layout-editorial`.
- `theme-rustic`: Compatible with `layout-list`, `layout-grid`, `layout-image-cards`, `layout-editorial`.
- `theme-contemporary`: Compatible with `layout-list`, `layout-grid`, `layout-image-cards`, `layout-editorial`.
- `theme-vibrant`: Compatible with `layout-list`, `layout-grid`, `layout-image-cards` (incompatible with editorial).
- `theme-editorial`: Compatible with `layout-editorial`, `layout-list`, `layout-grid`.
